action.new_text:
# Compute loss sums along the sequence dimension
    L_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)   # sums of log probs (negative)
    L_call = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_no   = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Margins: improvement over no-call baseline
    margin_with = L_no - L_with   # positive if with_result reduces loss
    margin_call = L_no - L_call

    # Keep candidate if both margins exceed the threshold (Toolformer filtering)
    keep = (margin_with > tau_filter) & (margin_call > tau_filter)
    return keep, margin_with
